ucs.title: [LLM] Cl0p (TA505 / GRACEFUL SPIDER) LemurLoot webshell drop into MOVEit Transfer wwwroot
ucs.description: Hunts for the IIS worker process (w3wp.exe) hosting MOVEit Transfer writing the LemurLoot webshell (human2.aspx and rotating variants) plus its randomly-named App_Web_*.dll companion into the MOVEitDMZ/wwwroot tree. This file-write chain is the post-exploitation signature of Cl0p's CVE-2023-34362 SQL-injection mass-exploitation campaign (May-June 2023, 2,700+ victims) and the same playbook is reused against GoAnywhere (CVE-2023-0669), Accellion FTA, and Cleo Harmony — i.e. anywhere they pop a managed-file-transfer appliance.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as file_path values(Filesystem.file_hash) as file_hash values(Filesystem.process_name) as parent_proc from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.process_name="w3wp.exe" Filesystem.file_path IN ("*\\wwwroot\\*") (Filesystem.file_name="human2.aspx" OR Filesystem.file_name="human.aspx" OR Filesystem.file_name="Human2.aspx" OR Filesystem.file_name="_human2.aspx" OR Filesystem.file_name="App_Web_*.dll") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.action | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | search dest=*moveit* OR file_path=*MOVEitDMZ* OR file_path=*MOVEitTransfer* | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 90d;
let WebshellNames = dynamic(["human2.aspx","human.aspx","_human2.aspx","human2.aspx_","Human2.aspx"]);
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("MOVEitDMZ","MOVEitTransfer","-ap MOVEit")
| where FolderPath has @"wwwroot"
| where FileName in~ (WebshellNames)
      or (FileName matches regex @"(?i)^human[0-9]?\.aspx?$")
      or (FileName endswith ".dll" and FileName startswith "App_Web_")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"  // exclude SYSTEM-only legit MOVEit installer writes if needed
   or FileName !startswith "App_Web_"               // installer DLLs are SYSTEM; webshell-DLLs land beside the .aspx
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256,
          InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessAccountDomain,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessId
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 90d;
let WebshellNames = dynamic(["human2.aspx","human.aspx","_human2.aspx","human2.aspx_","Human2.aspx"]);
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ActingProcessName =~ "w3wp.exe"
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("MOVEitDMZ","MOVEitTransfer","-ap MOVEit")
| where TargetFilePath has @"wwwroot"
| where TargetFileName in~ (WebshellNames)
      or TargetFileName matches regex @"(?i)^human[0-9]?\.aspx?$"
      or (TargetFileName endswith ".dll" and TargetFileName startswith "App_Web_")
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, TargetFileName, TargetFilePath,
          TargetFileSHA256, ActorUsername, ActingProcessCommandLine, EventProduct
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Cl0p LemurLoot Webshell Dropped by MOVEit IIS Worker
id: 8c0fb1ad-cl0p-moveit-lemurloot
status: stable
description: w3wp.exe hosting the MOVEit Transfer application pool writes the LemurLoot ASPX webshell (human2.aspx and variants) into wwwroot. Hallmark of Cl0p / TA505 / FIN11 CVE-2023-34362 exploitation.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/06/15/clop-ransomware-cve-2023-34362-moveit
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/zero-day-moveit-data-theft
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2023/06/15
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1505.003
  - attack.g0092
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    Image|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'MOVEitDMZ'
      - 'MOVEitTransfer'
      - '-ap MOVEit'
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains: '\wwwroot\'
  selection_name:
    TargetFilename|re|i: 'human[0-9]?\.aspx?$'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_path and selection_name
falsepositives:
  - None observed. Legitimate MOVEit upgrades do not deposit files named human*.aspx into wwwroot.
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 (@Image:(*\\w3wp.exe OR *\\W3WP.EXE OR *\\W3WP.exe)) (@ParentCommandLine:(*MOVEitDMZ* OR *MOVEitTransfer* OR *MOVEit*) OR @CommandLine:(*MOVEitDMZ* OR *MOVEitTransfer*)) (@TargetFilename:(*\\wwwroot\\human2.aspx OR *\\wwwroot\\human.aspx OR *\\wwwroot\\Human2.aspx OR *\\wwwroot\\_human2.aspx) OR @TargetFilename:(*\\wwwroot\\App_Web_*.dll))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten ContextImageFileName=/\\w3wp\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)\\\\wwwroot\\\\", field=TargetFileName)
| TargetFileName=/(?i)\\\\(human[0-9]?\.aspx?|App_Web_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.dll)$/
| join({#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\w3wp\.exe$/i CommandLine=/MOVEit(DMZ|Transfer)/i}, field=[aid, ContextProcessId=RawProcessId], include=[CommandLine])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName], function={ min(_time, as=firstSeen) | max(_time, as=lastSeen) | count(as=writes) | selectFromMax(field=_time, include=[CommandLine, SHA256HashData]) })
| sort(lastSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: MOVEit Transfer is the appliance Cl0p famously exploited in May 2023 via SQL-injection (CVE-2023-34362) to plant LemurLoot — Microsoft tracks the activity as Lace Tempest / Storm-0950 and attributes the deployment to Cl0p (CrowdStrike: GRACEFUL SPIDER). The signature of that intrusion is precisely w3wp.exe (running the MOVEit IIS app pool, identified by the `-ap MOVEit*` argument) writing an .aspx

ucs.title: [LLM] Cl0p Cleo MFT autorun exploitation — Harmony/VLTrader/LexiCom service spawning interpreters
ucs.description: Hunts for the late-2024 Cl0p campaign against Cleo Harmony, VLTrader, and LexiCom MFT software (CVE-2024-50623 / CVE-2024-55956). The exploit drops a malicious XML/ZIP into the Cleo `autorun\` directory; the Cleo Java service auto-processes it and shells out — surfacing as the Cleo Java process or LexiCom.exe/VLTrader.exe/Harmony.exe spawning PowerShell/cmd, plus the 'Malichus' loader dropping into Cleo install paths. Cl0p publicly claimed responsibility for this campaign on their DLS in Dec 2024.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd values(Processes.process_hash) as child_hash from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name="javaw.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="java.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="LexiCom.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="VLTrader.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="Harmony.exe") (Processes.parent_process_path="*\\LexiCom\\*" OR Processes.parent_process_path="*\\VLTrader\\*" OR Processes.parent_process_path="*\\Harmony\\*" OR Processes.parent_process_path="*\\Cleo\\*") (Processes.process_name="cmd.exe" OR Processes.process_name="powershell.exe" OR Processes.process_name="pwsh.exe" OR Processes.process_name="wscript.exe" OR Processes.process_name="cscript.exe" OR Processes.process_name="rundll32.exe" OR Processes.process_name="regsvr32.exe" OR Processes.process_name="mshta.exe" OR Processes.process_name="bitsadmin.exe" OR Processes.process_name="certutil.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 60d;
let CleoParents = dynamic(["javaw.exe","java.exe","LexiCom.exe","VLTrader.exe","Harmony.exe"]);
let ShellChildren = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe"]);
let CleoPaths = dynamic([@"\LexiCom\", @"\VLTrader\", @"\Harmony\", @"\Cleo\"]);
let ExecChains = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (CleoParents)
    | where InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (CleoPaths)
    | where FileName in~ (ShellChildren)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
         or FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","regsvr32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe")  // SYSCTX legit-ish for cmd, never for the rest
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage  = FolderPath,
              ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
              SHA256;
let AutorunDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\autorun\", @"\autorun_\")
    | where FolderPath has_any (CleoPaths)
    | where FileName endswith ".xml" or FileName endswith ".zip" or FileName endswith ".ahf"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, DroppedFile = FileName, DropPath = FolderPath,
              Writer = InitiatingProcessFileName, WriterCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
ExecChains
| union AutorunDrops
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 60d;
let CleoParents = dynamic(["javaw.exe","java.exe","LexiCom.exe","VLTrader.exe","Harmony.exe"]);
let ShellChildren = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe"]);
let CleoPaths = dynamic([@"\LexiCom\", @"\VLTrader\", @"\Harmony\", @"\Cleo\"]);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| extend ParentName = tolower(ParentProcessName)
| extend ChildName = tolower(TargetProcessName)
| where ParentName has_any (CleoParents)
| where ParentProcessCommandLine has_any (CleoPaths)
      or ActingProcessCommandLine has_any (CleoPaths)
| where ChildName has_any (ShellChildren)
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine,
          TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine = ActingProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc

  category: process_creation
